title: Japan vows continued security aid to PH despite income upgrade

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Japan will continue providing security assistance to the Philippines despite its recent classification as an upper-middle-income economy, a Japanese foreign ministry official said on Wednesday. Japanese Foreign Press Secretary Toshihiro Kitamura said Tokyo’s Official Security Assistance (OSA) program was not tied to a recipient country’s economic classification, unlike certain forms of development assistance. READ: PH’s upper-middle-income status: Milestone or mirage? “Our assistance in the field of security in the form of OSA, that will continue. That has nothing to do with the classification based on the GDP,” Kitamura said during a press briefing in Manila. He explained that while […]...
